data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (World Bank, then Wikipedia, then a composed mail with the same subject and body template) and it separates the recipient name from the email. But it ends by sending the email instead of clicking Discard, which is a harmful error. It also adds an ISO currency code that wasn't asked for, and it makes the recipient_email and recipient_name parameters separate when the true workflow uses one {client}. The tab switching and the search-box interactions are vague too.
